### :material-code-braces: Template variables

Variables you provide when running the template — `DATA_ROOT` via `--data-root`, the rest via `--var NAME=value`:

| Variable | Required | Description |
|---|:--:|---|
| `DATA_ROOT` | ✓ | proteinfold output directory (one directory per engine, e.g. alphafold2/, colabfold/, esmfold/, plus multiqc/ and pipeline_info/). |
| `METADATA_FILE` | — | The samplesheet the run was started with (--input: id, fasta, any extra design columns). Defaults to input/samplesheet.csv under DATA_ROOT. |
| `METADATA_ID_COL` | — | Samplesheet id column. proteinfold fixes it to id (the target name every output file carries); recorded for auto-detection only. |
| `GROUP_COL` | — | Target hub column the dashboard groups and filters targets by. Defaults to assembly (single chain or complex, derived from the structures); any samplesheet column works. |
| `GROUP_COL_DISPLAY` | — | Reader-facing label of GROUP_COL, used in filter and card titles. |

### :material-database-outline: Data collections

### :material-chef-hat: Recipes

Each recipe reshapes raw pipeline output into a tidy table. The name links to its source; *Output* lists the validated `EXPECTED_SCHEMA` columns.

| Recipe | Transforms | Output |
|---|---|---|
| [`nf-core/proteinfold/structures.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/proteinfold/recipes/structures.py) | Structure table for nf-core/proteinfold: one row per top-ranked structure. | `entity`, `structure`, `engine`, `target`, `n_chains`, `n_residues`, `mean_plddt`, `confident_pct`, `very_low_pct`, `n_models`, `ptm`, `iptm` |
| [`nf-core/proteinfold/targets.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/proteinfold/recipes/targets.py) | Target hub for nf-core/proteinfold: one row per target of the samplesheet. | `target`, `assembly`, `n_chains`, `n_residues`, `n_engines`, `engines`, `sequence`, `fasta` |
| [`proteinfold/engine_plddt.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/proteinfold/engine_plddt.py) | Per-residue confidence of each engine's top-ranked model, one curve per engine. | `target`, `series`, `chain`, `position`, `plddt` |
| [`proteinfold/models.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/proteinfold/models.py) | Confidence of every predicted model, one row per structure entity and model rank. | `model_id`, `structure`, `entity`, `engine`, `target`, `model_rank`, `is_top`, `n_residues`, `mean_plddt`, `confident_pct`, `very_low_pct`, `ptm`, `iptm`, `ipsae` |
| [`proteinfold/msa.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/proteinfold/msa.py) | The multiple sequence alignment each MSA-based engine folded from. | `msa_id`, `seq_id`, `rank`, `aligned_sequence`, `identity`, `coverage`, `chains`, `entity`, `engine`, `target`, `depth` |
| [`proteinfold/pae.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/proteinfold/pae.py) | Predicted aligned error of every top-ranked model, binned to a fixed grid. | `entity`, `engine`, `target`, `bin`, `residue_range`, `mean_pae`, `b01`, `b02`, `b03`, `b04`, `b05`, `b06`, `b07`, `b08`, `b09`, `b10`, `b11`, `b12`, `b13`, `b14`, `b15`, `b16`, `b17`, `b18`, `b19`, `b20`, `b21`, `b22`, `b23`, `b24`, `b25`, `b26`, `b27`, `b28`, `b29`, `b30`, `b31`, `b32`, `b33`, `b34`, `b35`, `b36`, `b37`, `b38`, `b39`, `b40`, `b41`, `b42`, `b43`, `b44`, `b45`, `b46`, `b47`, `b48`, `b49`, `b50`, `b51`, `b52`, `b53`, `b54`, `b55`, `b56`, `b57`, `b58`, `b59`, `b60`, `b61`, `b62`, `b63`, `b64` |
| [`proteinfold/plddt_ranks.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/proteinfold/plddt_ranks.py) | Per-residue pLDDT of each engine's models: the top-ranked curve and their spread. | `entity`, `engine`, `target`, `n_models`, `residue_index`, `plddt`, `plddt_min`, `plddt_max` |
| [`proteinfold/residues.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/proteinfold/residues.py) | Per-residue confidence of every top-ranked structure, one row per residue. | `entity`, `engine`, `target`, `chain`, `position`, `residue`, `value`, `category`, `confidently_placed` |
